$comment: Structural budgets for the feed row-cost harness (issue #1103). Exact counts, not timings: they are deterministic, so they can gate CI. Lower a ceiling when an optimization lands; raising one is a decision to write down in the PR. Bloom 7.31 + react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 (inline video on iPhone Safari): text hostNodes 52.125 -> 53.125 because Bloom 7.9.2 gives the avatar placeholder image its own positioned wrapper so it paints above the absolute shape fill on web; linkPreview contextReads 53 -> 55 because react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 re-runs an interop component's rule effect after commit (its StrictMode-safe subscription), so the link card's interop Pressable reads its two CSS contexts twice on mount. Bloom 10.7.0 (Alia's live avatar on the Ask Alia button): linkPreview contextReads 55 -> 56 because Bloom's Avatar now also calls useMessages(AGENT_AVATAR_MESSAGES) for its character-face label, a second LocaleContext read on every Avatar even when it draws no character (every avatar row gains one; only linkPreview had no headroom). Bloom can read that catalog only in the character branch and give this back. Bloom 11.1.0: text componentsPerRow 195 -> 196. Comparing the real text-row fiber trees on main 319ab1dd6 and the update (eight rows), each native Image becomes BloomImage + ExpoImage: +1 component per row, with no extra host nodes or requests. Every other ceiling is unchanged. Bloom inline post Markdown: comparing main a686b2525 (Bloom 12.2.0) against the real shared InlineMarkdown renderer adds one component, one theme context read and one hook per post body; quote rows render two bodies. Host nodes, requests and unrelated-row renders are unchanged. Raise only exhausted component ceilings: text 196 -> 197 and quote 266 -> 268. Other ceilings retain their existing headroom. Avatar prefetch removed from PostItem (the row's own Avatar loads the same image in the same commit): every avatar row loses its one request and the hooks of useImagePreload, so requestsPerRow is 0 for every kind, the fling's requests per post visited 1 -> 0, and hooksPerRow drops to the measured values (text 293 -> 272, quote 488 -> 445). Bloom 15.10.1 -> 15.16.0: linkPreview hooksPerRow 331 -> 351 and contextReadsPerRow 56 -> 77. Bisected over published versions: 15.11.0 still fits, 15.14.1 adds +14 hooks / +12 context reads and 15.16.0 +6 / +9 more, all inside the one Bloom LinkPreviewCard (its own source is unchanged since 15.1.0, so the cost comes from the Bloom primitives it renders); no other kind moved and host nodes, components and requests are unchanged. Raised to the measured values; lower them if Bloom trims those primitives. The ⋯ menu is Bloom's DropdownMenu owned by PostHeader (Bloom DropdownMenu directly, no app adapter): the open state is one hook per row (+1 hooksPerRow for every kind; quote renders two headers, so +2 hooks and +2 components). The menu content is lazy and mounts only while open, so nothing else is paid per row. Persistent video handoff: after removing the unused native loading subscription and driving web HLS loading directly from the shared controller, video hooksPerRow 384 -> 414 and contextReadsPerRow 43 -> 44. The persistent PlaybackVideoView adds one component (230 -> 231) and owns the view lease, serialized source replacement and first-frame handoff; shared playback authority keeps presenters from issuing competing commands. Actual host nodes (60.125), renders per mount (2), network requests (0), query observers (0), unrelated-row renders (0) and 200-post fling requests (0) are unchanged. Only these two video ceilings increase; all others stay fixed. Send in Allo (Instagram's paper plane, OxyHQ/Mention#1609): the post action bar gains one Bloom PressableScale. Measured on the text row with the button removed, with the button and no icon, and with the icon: the PressableScale is +21 hooks, +2 context reads and +8 components per row (the same primitive every other action-bar button is), and the Bloom RiSendPlaneLine icon +1 component; host nodes stay inside their ceilings and requests, observers, renders and unrelated-row renders are unchanged. hooksPerRow and contextReadsPerRow are raised to the measured values for every kind, and componentsPerRow for every kind but linkPreview, which had the headroom; the way to give this back is a cheaper PressableScale in Bloom, which every action-bar button would share. Post action bar on Bloom 15.24.0's EngagementBar (PostActions rebuilt; Mention's AnimatedLikeIcon, CountWheel and VotePill deleted): each action is one react-native Pressable with its glyph and, with a count, one Text; the bar resolves paint, count format and haptics once and its actions read one context and hold one state slot; the like's pop and count roll mount only on an accepted press. Measured before/after on the same tree (Bloom 15.22.0 -> 15.24.0), per row, every kind moves the same: components -24 (text 157 -> 133), hooks -65 (text 279 -> 214), context reads -7 (text 33 -> 26), host nodes -1 (text 38.125 -> 37.125), renders per mount 2 -> 1 for every kind but linkPreview (2); requests, observers, unrelated-row renders and fling requests are unchanged. One action at rest under this harness: a PressableScale button was 9 fibers / 21 hook slots / 2 context reads, an EngagementAction is 6 / 11 / 1 (10 of the 11 slots are react-native's Pressable). Every component, hook, context-read and host-node ceiling is lowered to the measured value, including the headroom earlier changes had left. Stored agent avatar adoption (Bloom 15.60.6 -> 15.79.1): AccountAvatar adds one React policy component per author (quote: two), with no hooks, host nodes or copied renderer. AccountAvatarGroup mounts capability subscriptions only for rendered groups with valid stored bot characters, so absent and photo-only groups pay none. The shared photo-error observer is opt-in; ordinary feed photos do not mount it. Bloom 15.79.0 also removes unconditional avatar press-state hooks and native surface-bake subscriptions. Measured on the real row tree with the 15.79.1 package: text hooks 214 -> 210, contexts 26 -> 25, components 133 -> 134; quote hooks 388 -> 380, contexts 43 -> 41, components 206 -> 208. LinkPreview remains at 63 context reads (the shared increased-contrast context offsets the removed avatar context) and hooks 292 -> 288. Lower every hook/context ceiling to these measurements and raise only the one policy-component cost per author; host nodes, requests, observers, renders, isolation and fling limits are unchanged. These structural counts are not device frame-rate measurements. Thread hover subscriptions moved from every PostItem to only the thread overlay, while pointer ownership is per mounted instance and released on recycle. The real row harness measures text hooks 210 -> 203 and quote 380 -> 366; every non-quote kind drops 7 slots. Host nodes, components, context reads, requests, query observers and unrelated-row renders remain unchanged. On a four-row fixture (three thread rows and one standalone), thread-store subscriptions fall from eight to three, and a hover no longer re-renders either PostItem in its thread. These are structural counts, not device frame-rate measurements.
